name: Adobe Acrobat Sign
description: Adobe Acrobat Sign routes and tracks electronic-signature agreements.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Adobe Acrobat Sign user through Relay-owned OAuth with exactly agreement_read:self. Two wrappers list up to 25 first-page self-owned agreement summaries or inspect one explicit agreement's status metadata. Relay excludes participants, documents, signing URLs, messages, form data, audit trails, writes, group/account/admin authority, raw paths, arbitrary queries, pagination, polling, retries, and exports.

capabilities.label: List agreements
capabilities.description: Read a bounded first page of self-owned agreement summaries.

capabilities.label: Inspect agreement status
capabilities.description: Read status and lifecycle metadata for one explicit agreement.

allowed.label: List agreement summaries
allowed.description: List up to 25 first-page agreement status summaries owned by the connected user.

allowed.label: Inspect an agreement
allowed.description: Inspect status and lifecycle metadata for one explicit agreement ID.

blocked.label: Access private agreement content
blocked.description: Documents, downloads, participant identity, messages, form data, signing URLs, audit trails, and authentication details are blocked.

blocked.label: Mutate agreements
blocked.description: Creating, sending, signing, delegating, cancelling, deleting, reminding, uploading, and modifying agreements are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broader authority
blocked.description: Group, account, library, widget, workflow, webhook, admin, and impersonation access are blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw or bulk APIs
blocked.description: Raw paths, arbitrary queries, pagination, polling, automatic retries, batch access, and exports are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Read-only agreement status
approvalProfiles.description: Two bounded self-owned agreement reads run automatically; private content, writes, broader authority, raw access, and bulk transfer remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The self-only scope, fixed shard, fixed paths, field redaction, result cap, and read-only boundary remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts two bounded agreement-status reads and attaches the self-scoped OAuth token server-side on the bound Adobe shard.
Relay mounts two bounded agreement-status reads and attaches the self-scoped OAuth token server-side on the bound Adobe shard.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's Adobe Acrobat Sign OAuth application, production client credentials, and any required Adobe enablement or review are not configured. No provider-console, credential, consent, Railway, or live acceptance work is authorized in this worker task.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized owner configures the exact Railway callback and agreement_read:self on a Relay-owned Adobe Acrobat Sign OAuth application, stores the client ID and secret through Railway's secret process, completes any provider review, deploys separately, and runs live connect, shard binding, list/get redaction, refresh, revoke/disconnect, and post-disconnect denial acceptance.

evidence.supports: Adobe documents OAuth 2.0, exact application scopes, agreement_read:self for reading agreements, and callback code, state, api_access_point, and web_access_point values.
Adobe documents one-hour access tokens, refresh tokens, and shard-specific token refresh and revocation endpoints.
Adobe documents sharded accounts and GET /api/rest/v6/base_uris for discovering and caching the exact apiAccessPoint.
Adobe documents REST API usage, agreement retrieval, paging, and rate-limit behavior; Relay caps one page and performs no polling or automatic retries.
